description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing calendar events in a database, using Room persistence library in an Android app. It provides methods to query, insert, update, and delete calendar event records.

classes.name: CalendarEventDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for performing database operations related to calendar events.

methods.name: getEventsForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CalendarEventEntity objects within the specified start and end time range.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Fetches calendar events that have been modified after the given timestamp.

methods.name: insertEvent
methods.description: Inserts a new calendar event into the database with conflict resolution strategy set to REPLACE.

methods.name: deleteEventById
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by its unique identifier.
